nearest_rule: floor(coordinate+0.5), integer native pixel centers; no alignment; retain duplicates
luminance: Encoded RGB weighted sum 0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B, explicitly not linear radiance
accounting: Pixel cells mean spatial pixels, with channel entries and payload bytes separately disclosed. Decode only two full target PNGs and the complete member from four NPZs; no source PNG or other array members.
stop: First header/hash/geometry/budget/deadline failure; no substitute subset or altered profile
